name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures an Nginx reverse proxy and web server for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including static sites, TLS, security headers, fail2ban, UFW, sysctl tuning, and SSH hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, service enablement, log directory creation, and required Redis configuration adjustments.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI application from GitHub with Python dependencies, a virtual environment, PostgreSQL database setup, environment configuration, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service.
